text:
kevin: quick check — RFC landed proposing a transient 'stitch-pin' API for prefix rehydrates instead of the existing soft-pin. https://rfc.redwood/stitch-pin  TL;DR: short-lived strong hold + async release to avoid long-lived pins that block eviction. thoughts?

lina: +1 to the idea in principle, worried about complexity around failure modes. if the async release is lost (node crash) how do we avoid leaked strong holds?

sam: we can attach a lease TTL to the stitch-pin and let the eviction path treat expired leases as demote candidates. that keeps correctness but means slightly higher window for stale data.

ria: is there a perf/cost tradeoff vs current soft-pin? my concern: more short strong holds might reduce batching/coalescing and increase GPU memory churn. any bench numbers?

kevin: good point. I ran a tiny sim: 1s median TTL => +3% effective KV memory due to overlap in tails, but 0.5s TTL gives <1% increase. We should measure at real traffic.

lina: also need invariant: on handoff, recipient must validate stitch-pin epoch to avoid double-apply. That's currently missing from the RFC. we should add a handoff precondition (epoch match) or fallback to read-through.

sam: yep — add explicit transfer token in handoff RPC. simple pseudo: 
```
transfer(prefix, token) -> ok|retry
// token==epoch@owner
```
if retry then fallback to read-through.

ria: ops note: rollout plan should include a canary that runs stitch-pin with TTL=250ms in one pool and collects demote/readfall stats for 48h. we should also toggle `kv.rehydrate.simulate=false` so we actually exercise.

kevin: agreed on canary. propose gate: 1) compile-mode opt-in (flag), 2) canary 10% traffic in dev pool, 3) observe demote rate, spillovers, and read-latency. if no regressions, increase to 50% then GA.

lina: one more: telemetry fields to add — stitch_pin.ttl_ms, stitch_pin.release_success, stitch_pin.transfer_retry. we need those to correlate regressions.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout: stitch-pin canary -> dev-pool at 2025-06-12T15:00Z (ticket #1234).

sam: I'll draft a tiny test harness to replay hot-prefix traces with stitch-pin enabled. will post numbers tomorrow.

kevin: awesome. action items: sam drafts harness + bench, lina updates RFC with transfer-token precondition, ria owns canary run & telemetry dashboard. i'll make the rollout ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
